svg.title: All these inputs were obtained for the actual cost; a bound on the extensive value f(0, 0) is unnec- essary. Take the explicit four-dimensional counting bound c(a) = 16·6!e2aa−6. A distance shell of radius k has at most (2k + 1)4 sites. The exponential-series inequality ea(k+2) ≥[a(k + 2)]6/6! bounds its contribution by c(a)/[(k + 1)(k + 2)]. Summing the telescoping series gives P y e−a dist(z,y) ≤c(a), uniformly in the period. Bounded multiplicity changes this to Kc(a). Put D = Kc(a).
